definition: Each pixel is measured from the source bitmap. The 2019 east/central close squares have a fine bridging strip; the 2018 southern views show four open notches per bay. The two outer A4 light centres set that single bay’s spacing. The two original A/C exposures helped set the section and are rechecked against the built geometry. A separate exposure (E, bays 7 and 8) was digitised after fixing the geometry; those pixels are held out from the parapet section fitting.
